title: Boilermaking-Specific Hazards and Safety Controls
objective: Recognise that boilermaking has trade-specific hazards requiring authorised controls and supervision.
safety_boundary: Hazard recognition only. No confined-space, gas-system, electrical, fire-fighting or other hazardous operational instructions are provided.

sections.heading: 1. Trade-specific hazards
sections.body: Boilermaking environments may involve heat, energy, fumes, heavy materials, restricted spaces and other serious hazards.

sections.heading: 2. Protect others
sections.body: Controls must consider people nearby as well as the person performing the work.

sections.heading: 3. Authorised controls
sections.body: High-risk work requires applicable workplace controls, competent supervision and authorised procedures.

sections.heading: 4. Stop and refer
sections.body: A learner must not improvise when a hazard, control or instruction is unclear.

questions.question: Should a learner improvise if a control is unclear?
